## Claim (exclusive — one issue, one owner)

Before touching ANY file, post the FIRST comment:

```
CLAIM <slot> <provider> <UTC ISO-8601 timestamp>
```

Slots: OC-1, OC-2, OC-3, OC-4, ZC-1, ZC-2. Re-read the comments. The first valid
claim wins. If yours is not first, comment `RELEASE <slot> conflict` and STOP.
One agent per issue across ALL providers and harnesses. Two agents on one issue
is always a violation. A claim holds a 4-hour lease, refreshed by any later
comment from the claimant; an expired claim is revoked by the lead with
`REVOKE <slot> <issue#> <reason>` and returns to the shard pool.

## Ownership (primary guard)

```
shard(issue) = issue_number % 6
```

| shard | owner |
|---|---|
| 0 | OC-1 |
| 1 | OC-2 |
| 2 | OC-3 |
| 3 | OC-4 |
| 4 | ZC-1 |
| 5 | ZC-2 |

Work only issues in your shard, or in a shard the lead reassigned to you with
`SHARD-REASSIGN <shard> -> <slot>[,<slot>...]` on issue #379. `area:` labels
describe the work; they do not grant ownership.

## GATE -1 — SEARCH THE WHOLE REPO AND THE WHOLE INTERNET (MANDATORY)

Picking an issue is not permission to start. Before the first file edit, post one
comment recording BOTH searches:

```
SEARCH <slot>
repo: <exact commands> -> <paths/shas, or "none">
web: <exact queries + date> -> <urls, or "none">
verdict: NEW | DELTA <one line> | DONE <path> <sha>
```

Repo search covers the whole checkout, not just the obvious directory:

- `git log --all --oneline -- <deliverable path>`
- `git log -S "<distinctive term>" --oneline`
- `grep -rn "<distinctive term>" . --include='*.md' --include='*.py' --include='*.c' --include='*.csv'`
- `docs/REPO-STATE-MAP.md` for the per-family verdict

Web search covers GitHub code (excluding `adineo-cmd/*`), XDA, LWN, HN, Reddit,
arXiv/Scholar, kernel source and linux-firmware.

- `DONE` -> close as ALREADY-DONE, do not work.
- `DELTA` -> work only the delta.
- `NEW` -> proceed.

No SEARCH comment, no work. A commit without one is a protocol violation.

## GATE 0 — PRIOR ART BEFORE ANY WORK (MANDATORY)

The `web:` field of the SEARCH comment must record these exact queries and date:

1. GitHub code search (exclude `adineo-cmd/*`) for the exact format/family/SoC.
2. Web search (XDA, LWN, HN, Reddit, arXiv/Scholar, project docs).
3. Kernel source + linux-firmware + relevant upstream trees.
4. Record the EXACT query strings and the access date in a comment on this issue.

DECISION:
- If someone has ALREADY done this work (documented the format, written the
  driver, decoded the blob), post `PRIOR-ART <urls>` and CLOSE this issue as a
  duplicate. Do not rebuild it. Record what the prior art covers.
- If only PARTIAL overlap exists, keep the issue open and state the precise
  DELTA you will deliver in a `DELTA <one-line>` comment before starting.
- If NOTHING is found, post `NO-PRIOR-ART <queries + date>` and proceed.

No work may begin before one of PRIOR-ART / DELTA / NO-PRIOR-ART is posted.

## Discipline

- Facts-not-blobs: never commit a proprietary payload. Hashes, sizes, offsets,
  counts and <=16-byte hex samples only.
- Clean-room: implementation code ONLY from published specs and public GPL
  sources. Every implementation file carries a clean-room statement header.
- Every claim verified by command output before it is written.
- Honest negatives are deliverables. Report them; do not omit them.
- stdlib Python, `python3 -I`, no comments in code.
- Push when done (Rule 3): `DONE <remote-sha> <one-line result>`.

## Task
Write a byte-level clean-room spec for the `adsp` blob family from the measured facts: container layout, hash/signature rules, version fields and device reach. Add a stdlib parser under `implementations/<family>/` with a clean-room statement header and self-tests.

## Acceptance
- Gate 0 completed: PRIOR-ART (closed) or DELTA or NO-PRIOR-ART posted.
- Evidence-classed deliverable under research/ or implementations/.
- Every number verified by command output; source + access date.
- Honest-negative section if evidence runs out.
- No payload committed; clean-room header on all code.
- Pushed (Rule 3) with DONE <remote-sha> comment.
title: Proprietary blob spec: adsp family — clean-room format description
